**⚠️ major: Agent.run must accept and forward a messages= kwarg; not shown in diff**

All five call sites now pass `messages=...` to `Agent.run`. The diff does not show `Agent.run`'s signature, and the tests replace `run` with a stub `_run(task=None, messages=None, **kwargs)`, so they would pass even if the real `Agent.run` silently swallowed `messages` into `**kwargs` or raised TypeError. If `Agent.run` does not forward `messages` into the completion request, this change removes the history from the prompt entirely (the file blob is gone, the turns never arrive) and every agent after the planner runs context-free. A single test that calls the real `Agent.run` path with a mocked LLM client, asserting the turns reach the request payload, would close this.

**🔸 minor: _read_shared_state now has no caller, leaving the audit log unparsed and untested**

After this diff every call to `_read_shared_state` is removed. The method and the file-writing path remain, but nothing in the library reads the file back, so a regression in `_initialize_shared_state`/`_append_to_shared_state` formatting (or a write failure on a read-only workspace) is now invisible at runtime. The new test only asserts the file exists and contains two substrings. This is a deliberate decision per the PR description, but it is worth either marking the method as public API/audit accessor explicitly or adding a round-trip test that `_read_shared_state` still returns the full log.
